title: Claims of the DPoP proof (header typ dpop+jwt carrying the device's public jwk) the device sends in PROOF and again, with a fresh nonce, after RENEW. htm is GET, htu is https://<node host>[:port if not 443]/all-tunnel/2, ath is base64url(SHA-256(session token)), nonce is the node's CHALLENGE. Unknown extra claims are ignored (a token is not a closed shape), the listed ones are not optional unless the schema says so.
